normal.name: Sean Jordan | Sharing Great Games You Probably Never Played!
normal.text: Today on The Greatest Games You (Probably) Never Played, I take a look at Astal, one of Sega's early attempts to launch a new mascot for the Saturn. Clearly, Astal didn't have what it took. I wonder if it's because of anything superficial about his appearance? #gaming #videogames #retrogames
